requirements.title: Advancing input/output positions after the last record read or written absent error
requirements.definition: An advancing input/output statement always positions a record file after the last record read or written unless an error condition occurs.

pending.advancing-io-positions-after-last-record: Write or read two distinct records with advancing formatted sequential I/O, then perform the next read into a nonblank/nonzero sentinel and expect the following record, proving the file advanced past the last transferred record.
pending.advancing-io-error-exception: No portable oracle asserts a post-error position; future tests inducing errors must not depend on a subsequent position without first repositioning.

requirements.oracle: Plans are pending and source-derived. Positive plans establish a non-default state first (for example by writing known records, initializing variables to nonzero/nonblank sentinels, or creating a known file) and then observe only portable properties: exact internal records, successful IOSTAT zero, nonzero IOSTAT for a specified error condition, or named intrinsic status values where the standard names them. Processor-dependent unit numbers, file names, record lengths, storage-unit encodings, buffering, timing, IOMSG text, and specific error numbers are not asserted.

requirements.title: Nonadvancing input/output may leave a record file within the current or a subsequent record
requirements.definition: A nonadvancing input/output statement may position a record file at a character position within the current record or a subsequent record, and nonadvancing input/output can read or write a record by a sequence of data transfer statements each accessing part of the record.

pending.nonadvancing-may-position-within-current: Use nonadvancing formatted input on a record with distinctive adjacent fields, then continue reading into sentinels and expect continuation within the same record where 13.8.2 semantics fix the position.
pending.nonadvancing-may-position-subsequent-rec: Use nonadvancing I/O with a case that reaches a subsequent record under the registered 13.8.2 rules; assert only the subsequent record's distinctive data, not an implementation-specific column.
pending.nonadvancing-partial-record-sequence: Write or read a record in two nonadvancing transfers using distinctive first and second portions, with nonblank sentinels proving both portions were transferred.

requirements.title: Incomplete nonadvancing output is completed as corresponding advancing output before close or repositioning
requirements.definition: If a nonadvancing output statement leaves a file positioned within a current record and no further output statement for that file precedes close, BACKSPACE, ENDFILE, or REWIND, the effect is as if it were the corresponding advancing output statement.

pending.nonadvancing-output-completed-before-clo: Write distinctive partial-record text with nonadvancing output, close without further output, reopen and read the record with sentinels; expect the advancing-output record effect.
pending.nonadvancing-output-completed-before-bac: After distinctive nonadvancing output, execute one of BACKSPACE, ENDFILE, or REWIND before any further output and then read under registered rules; expect the same record data as the corresponding advancing output.
